details.availability: Public source with Compose files and Dockerfiles; needs a local GGUF model served by llama.cpp and a GPU; the author has put the project on hold.

code.basis: repository LICENSE header; GNU text does not say -only or -or-later; not a weights/data license

name: pebkac
notes: Containerized stack (Podman or Docker Compose): a FastAPI service wraps a Zendriver-controlled Chrome, and a SafeCodeAgent subclass of the smolagents CodeAgent calls it through tools for navigation, CSS-selector clicks, typing, key presses, Trafilatura content extraction, DuckDuckGo search, background tabs, API-response capture and a Cloudflare challenge handler, within a configurable step limit (default 10). The model reads page text and selectors; the screenshot tool only saves files, and the README lists vision assist as under consideration. Redis and DuckDB cache extracted content, per-site working selectors persist, and runs are logged to SQLite. The user watches and shares the browser over noVNC from a localhost control panel. The README markets anti-bot evasion and says the project is on hold. Root LICENSE is AGPL-3.0.
summary: Self-hosted web co-browser in which a smolagents code agent on a local llama.cpp model writes Python that drives Chrome through Zendriver: navigation, CSS-selector clicks and typing, Trafilatura text extraction and tabs.
